answer: EigenTrust reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, reciprocal honest service. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity lets trusted paths bridge participants, while the matrix mirrors evidence-backed endorsements. A fresh Sybil has negligible history and near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted incoming support, it cannot amplify its score or pass consensus thresholds, even if many identities join a river of collusion.
